questions.question: Have you ever learnt about outer space and stars?

segments.v: Yes, I learnt about space in physics and geography lessons. I also watch videos about space.
but most of what I know comes from YouTube. I
really. It makes all my exam worries seem tiny

fluency.band9: School learning → personal interest (a phase) → a reflective feeling.

lexical.band9: went through a phase, fascinated by, documentary, humbling, in comparison.

grammar.band6: “I also watch videos” is not connected to the first sentence.
grammar.band9: A what-clause (most of what I know comes from…), “every documentary I could find”, and “make + object + seem + adjective”.

analysis.keyDifference: Band 9 separates school learning from personal interest and ends with a reflective feeling.

vocabulary.definition: to have an interest or behaviour for a short period
vocabulary.example: He went through a phase of wearing only black.
vocabulary.vietnamese: trải qua một giai đoạn (mê cái gì)

vocabulary.definition: to be very interested in something

vocabulary.example: Meeting the old soldiers was a humbling experience.
vocabulary.vietnamese: khiến mình thấy nhỏ bé, khiêm nhường

vocabulary.example: My problems seem small in comparison.
